_readme: Your own (their message -> your reply) pairs live here, and they are what makes
a drafted reply sound like you rather than like an assistant.
They are learned, not written by hand: open a real conversation, then run the
screen_ai action learn_style. Each pair is saved with the contact it came from.
Nothing here is required for the plugin to work — with no examples it falls back
to the tone settings in memory/live_chat_style.json.
